name: Inventory costing United States (ASC 330 — full absorption costing; period charges excluded)

treatments.note: production overhead on materials — full absorption, ASC 330-10-30-1
variable and fixed production overhead; fixed overhead allocated on normal capacity, ASC 330-10-30-3
depreciation of production facilities, part of production overhead
abnormal idle facility expense is a current-period charge, ASC 330-10-30-7
general and administrative expenses are period charges, ASC 330-10-30-8 — this is where US GAAP differs from § 255 Abs. 2 HGB, which leaves it to the preparer
research and development is expensed as incurred, ASC 730-10-25-1
selling expenses are period charges, ASC 330-10-30-8
